clause: Parametric shape catalog core + registry + expand [STU-VEC-010 core,STU-VEC-011]

scope.summary: Implement the parametric shape catalog core + extensible registry for the primary shapes (Rectangle, Ellipse/Arc, Polygon, Star, Line/Segment) as live StudioVectorPath/StudioVectorNetwork with per-shape editable parameter schemas, plus the explicit history-tracked expand-to-raw-geometry command. Adding a shape is registering a new parameter schema against the same shape-primitive contract (no new layer kind, no parallel geometry model).
acceptance_criteria: core parametric shapes live + expandable via registry; author_ids + manual entry
proof_targets: Argus shape-tool inspect + live-param + expand test
expected_tests: argus: shape tools (rect/ellipse/polygon/star/line) reachable via author_id
test: each shape keeps live parameters; expand is explicit one-history-entry command; registry accepts new schema without new layer kind

target_entries: Studio / Vector / Parametric shapes (rectangle, ellipse, polygon, star, line)

risk_if_missed: No parametric shapes; primitive drawing + live parameters missing.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
